summary: The Republic of Türkiye filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1.5bn sovereign bond offering of 7.500% notes due January 30, 2037. Notes priced at 98.957% of par, implying about $1.484bn gross and $1.483bn net proceeds after a 0.070% underwriting discount. Interest pays semi-annually from January 30, 2027. Notes are direct, general, unconditional sovereign obligations backed by full faith and credit, include collective action clauses, and are expected to settle September 30, 2026, via DTC book-entry. Joint bookrunners are BNP Paribas, Citigroup, ING and J.P. Morgan. Listing is sought on the London Stock Exchange ISM. This is a routine sovereign debt issuance, not a special situation.
